title: Pure Battlewasp
summary: Battlewasp cards only, with generic Insect Extra Deck monsters and staples. The 2024 cards lead. Battlewasp - Rapier the Onslaught discards another Insect to place Battlewasp Wind from the Deck and summon itself. Battlewasp Wind then searches a smaller Battlewasp twice per turn, whenever one is summoned, and lets an Insect act as a Tuner. Sting the Poison searches, Twinbow and Pin summon themselves, and the swarm climbs into Insect Synchros. Battlewasp - Sachi the Ceremonial Bow becomes a Tuner and grants an extra Normal Summon. Battlewasp - Grand Partisan the Revolution can't be destroyed by effects and wipes their cards when banished. Rapier, Twinbow, Dart and Summoning Swarm lock the Extra Deck to Insects, so the Extra Deck is all Insect.
